title: The Chess Game Begins
next_chapter_hook: A gleam of sharp light flashed in the Crown Prince's deep eyes, his lips curving into a meaningful smile: "Elder Chen, there is something this prince does not understand — just who exactly are you?" The undercurrents beneath the court had already begun to stir quietly.

text.content: Before the golden light of the fourth page of the Tianji Record faded, Chen Ji felt some dormant power within him fully awakened. He opened his eyes, and the surrounding ruins seemed veiled in a pale golden mist — that was the new vision brought by the complete manifestation of the Tianji Record. He lowered his gaze to his palm, sensing the Heavenly Fate force flowing through his meridians with unprecedented clarity. The knowledge unlocked by the fourth page told him that the seventh Heavenly Fate Fragment lay at the core of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, but this information itself was like a double-edged sword: it was both a guide forward and a dangerous signal that could bring lethal misfortune. Master Mo's voice echoed in his mind, carrying rare gravity: "The chess game has begun, and you have no way back." Chen Ji drew a deep breath, raising his eyes to the sky beyond the ruins, tinged crimson by the morning light. From this moment, he would no longer be the waste servant of the Tianqing Sect, but a new chess piece destined to make waves across the imperial dynasty — Crown Prince's Grand Tutor Chen Xuanji.

dialogue.content: "Chen公子, everything is ready." Ye Qing's voice penetrated the formation from outside the hall: "The Crown Prince's introduction has been arranged, and three days from now will be your official debut at court." She paused, her tone carrying a hint of gravity: "However... on my way here, I noticed some suspicious traces. Someone seems to be secretly investigating your identity." A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips — cold and从容. He had long anticipated this — from the moment he faked his death in the ruins, there would inevitably be sharp-nosed individuals trying to excavate the truth. The only question was who was investigating him, and how much information they possessed. He pushed open the hall door, the cool morning breeze brushing his face, instantly refreshing his drowsy mind.

text.content: Ye Qing stood outside, her black劲装 outlining a heroic and fierce silhouette. Her gaze was more complex than three days prior — that "truth" from the prophecy had given her an ineffable mix of emotions toward this man: reverence, curiosity, and a trace of dependence. "Come in." Chen Ji stepped aside, his eyes falling on the stack of secret letters Ye Qing presented: "Tell me everything that happened in the capital over these three days, without missing a single detail." His tone was calm yet carried undeniable authority. Ye Qing's heart stirred; she realized the aura radiating from this man was worlds apart from the waste servant she remembered. Suppressing the turbulent waves in her heart, she handed over the letters: "The capital is seething with undercurrents. The Crown Prince's and Second Prince's struggle for succession grows increasingly fierce. Representatives of the major sects at court are all watching, and your appearance... has precisely broken this balance."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing unfolded a secret letter marked with several annotations: "This is intelligence collected through my network at the Holy Sect. The Crown Prince seems... unsurprised that you were introduced by his teacher. But the Second Prince's faction has begun secretly investigating your background — they suspect you are connected to the destruction of the Tianqing Sect." Chen Ji took the letter, scanned it quickly, and tucked it into his sleeve. News of the Tianqing Sect's destruction had spread throughout the cultivation world — it was both the result of his scheme and a vulnerability to his identity. The name Chen Ji would sooner or later be dug up. After a moment of contemplation, he raised his eyes to Ye Qing: "What is the Crown Prince's attitude? Does he truly trust me, or does he have ulterior motives?" Ye Qing shook her head: "That Crown Prince is extremely scheming; I cannot see through him. But one thing is certain — he needs a chess piece to help him oppose the forces behind the Second Prince, and your appearance conveniently fills that gap."

text.content: Chen Ji walked to the window, gazing toward the distant capital, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes. Crown Prince's Grand Tutor — this identity was already a masterstroke in his grand scheme, but he knew only too well that once a chess game begins, countless unexpected factors would surge in. He turned around, his burning gaze fixed on Ye Qing: "I need you to establish an intelligence outpost in the capital, monitoring the movements of every faction at court. Any clue threatening my identity must be nipped in the bud immediately." Ye Qing nodded slightly, then showed a hint of worry: "Chen公子, such large-scale operations require massive resources and manpower. With our current forces, I'm afraid..." Chen Ji raised his hand to interrupt her, drawing a token from his sleeve — a token Master Mo had given him when he left the ruins, engraved with an ancient rune. "Take this to Ink Fragrance Pavilion in the East Market of the capital. Someone will meet you." His voice was low yet confident: "Before I set foot in the capital, I had already secretly placed three distant pieces. Ye Qing, now it's time for you to know one of them."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing took the token, and the moment her fingertips touched the ancient rune, a warm force instantly surged into her body, making her involuntarily shudder. Her gaze toward Chen Ji transformed completely — just when had this man begun setting up such intricate schemes? His depth of scheming was truly terrifying. She drew a deep breath and tucked the token into her chest: "Understood. I'll go immediately." She turned to leave, then suddenly stopped, looking back at Chen Ji: "By the way, there's one more thing. On my way here, I discovered someone was following me — a person from the Xuanwu Sect." Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly. The Xuanwu Sect... Han Lie's people? This world was truly laughably small. As he was about to speak, the Tianji Record in his sleeve suddenly grew warm — that familiar sensation told him someone was using divination techniques attempting to probe his location. He coldly smiled, fingers gently forming seals within his sleeve, completely concealing the Tianji Record's aura. "Interesting. It seems my new Grand Tutor already has someone eager to make a move."

choice.prompt: Facing the Xuanwu Sect's probing, Chen Ji must choose how to establish his footing in the imperial dynasty: confront with a formidable stance to intimidate potential adversaries, or continue to hide and lie in wait?

choices.text: Take the Initiative to Establish Authority
choices.description: Utilize the prestige of his new identity to proactively display strength at court, causing all those with designs on him to retreat
choices.visible_cost: Revealing part of his strength may attract more powerful enemies
choices.visible_reward: Rapidly establish prestige, making the Crown Prince value him even more
choices.risk_hint: Being overly ostentatious may attract the attention of the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.process_label: 陈机决定主动出击，以强势姿态亮相

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned sharp as a blade. He strode toward the door, his entire aura shifting dramatically — that was the sharpness and composure沉淀 after surviving life and death. "Since they want to probe, let them witness what a true Crown Prince's Grand Tutor is." Ye Qing watched his retreating figure, an ineffable fervor rising in her heart. She suddenly realized this man was no ordinary being — his stage was the entire world. "I'm coming with you." Ye Qing hurried to follow, her voice carrying a hint of excitement: "Since we're establishing authority, let's show them what the Demon Path's Holy Maiden can do!"

choices.text: Continue to Lie in Wait and Investigate Secretly
choices.description: Secretly investigate the Xuanwu Sect's intentions, wait until the mastermind behind the scenes is found before making plans
choices.visible_cost: May miss the golden opportunity to establish prestige
choices.visible_reward: After grasping the enemy's trump cards, strike with lethal precision
choices.risk_hint: Passively waiting may allow the enemy to act first
choices.process_label: 陈机决定继续潜伏，先摸清对手底细

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shook his head with a light laugh, that smile carrying a playful amusement: "Why rush? Let them jump first." He turned back to the desk, taking out a blank talisman paper, and with swift strokes, outlined a complex formation pattern. "The person following you was an outer disciple of the Xuanwu Sect, cultivation not high, but there must be a master guiding them from behind. You deliberately expose flaws for them to follow, then quietly plant this formation on them." He handed the talisman paper to Ye Qing, his eyes gleaming with calculating light: "Within three days, I want to know every piece of intelligence they transmit." Ye Qing took the talisman paper, her gaze toward Chen Ji filled with admiration. The depth of this man's schemes was truly beyond her reach.

text.content: Three days later, the Taihe Palace in the capital. Chen Ji, dressed in a brand-new Grand Tutor's official robe, slowly entered the hall amid the watchful gazes of the civil and military officials. His pace was unhurried, each step hitting perfect rhythm — neither too hasty nor too sluggish. On that unfamiliar yet youthful face hung a faint smile, his eyes so profound they seemed capable of seeing through human hearts. The officials whispered amongst themselves, their gazes filled with curiosity and scrutiny. Crown Prince's Grand Tutor — this position, though holding no actual power at court, had been valued by successive emperors due to its direct connection to teaching the Crown Prince. What abilities did this suddenly-appeared young man possess that the Crown Prince personally requested him? Just as murmurs filled the hall, a commotion suddenly arose outside the palace. A young man in dark purple brocade robes strode into the hall, his gaze like lightning striking Chen Ji — it was Zhao Wuhen, chief strategist for the Second Prince and inner disciple of the Xuanwu Sect.

dialogue.content: Zhao Wuhen stopped three paces before Chen Ji, a meaningful smile hanging at his lips: "Long have I admired Elder Chen's great name. Meeting you today, your bearing is indeed extraordinary." His tone was courteous, but those eyes were like two sharp daggers, seemingly wanting to see through Chen Ji: "May I ask, Elder Chen, who was your master? I happen to have some acquaintance with several elders of the Tianqing Sect, yet I have never heard of the Elder's name." At these words, the atmosphere in the court instantly became subtle. The Tianqing Sect's destruction was only months past; Zhao Wuhen bringing up this name now clearly implied something. Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, merely tilting his head slightly to look at Zhao Wuhen, a playful gleam flickering in his eyes: "Oh? Official Zhao has connections with the Tianqing Sect?" His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears: "What a coincidence — on the day the Tianqing Sect was destroyed, where was Official Zhao?" These words were like a stone splashing into a calm lake, stirring endless ripples. The court erupted in an uproar, and the officials' gazes toward Zhao Wuhen instantly became meaningful.

choice.prompt: Zhao Wuhen's probing caused the court atmosphere to tense abruptly. Chen Ji must decide how to respond to this potential threat:

choices.description: Expose Zhao Wuhen's connection to the destruction of Tianqing Sect, making him a laughingstock in public
choices.visible_cost: Completely offend the Second Prince's faction
choices.visible_reward: Establish prestige in the imperial court, letting everyone know the new Grand Tutor is not to be trifled with
choices.risk_hint: Evidence has not been fully gathered, may be counterattacked
choices.process_label: 陈机决定当场反击，打压赵无痕气焰

dialogue.content: Chen Ji smiled gently, that smile warm to the point of compassion, but what he said was like a soft blade coated with poison: "Since Lord Zhao has connections with Tianqing Sect, you must be well acquainted with the people within the sect. Then I wonder..." He took out a jade pendant from his sleeve and casually tossed it to Zhao Wuhen, "Does Lord Zhao recognize this jade pendant?" Zhao Wuhen took the jade pendant, his face instantly changed dramatically—it was a token used by Xuanwu Sect to pass secret orders, still bearing his aura. Chen Ji's voice leisurely sounded: "Three days ago, someone used this jade pendant to transmit intelligence near the Tianqing Sect ruins. Unfortunately, luck wasn't on their side, I happened to witness it." The court fell into dead silence, then erupted into even greater commotion. Zhao Wuhen's face was ashen green, he never expected this seemingly harmless new Grand Tutor to strike with lethal precision!

choices.text: Knowing when to stop, stopping at the right point
choices.description: Not completely tearing apart relations, leaving room for maneuver for both sides
choices.visible_cost: May be perceived as weak and easily bullied
choices.visible_reward: Let enemies lower their guard, secretly grasp more leverage
choices.risk_hint: Zhao Wuhen may become even more presumptuous
choices.process_label: 陈机选择隐忍，不与赵无痕正面冲突

text.content: Chen Ji smiled calmly, unhurriedly retrieving the jade pendant into his sleeve. His gaze was placid as water, showing no emotional fluctuations: "Lord Zhao is joking. I'm merely a newly arrived scholar, how would I understand these sect secrets?" His retreat made Zhao Wuhen pause momentarily, then a satisfied smirk appeared on his face. Just as he prepared to continue his questioning, a eunuch's sharp voice came from outside the hall: "The Crown Prince arrives—" Everyone's attention instantly shifted. Zhao Wuhen had to temporarily abandon his plans. Before leaving, he whispered to Chen Ji: "Grand Tutor Chen, conduct yourself wisely." Chen Ji watched his retreating figure, a subtle cold glint flickering in his eyes. Conduct yourself wisely? These words, he would remember.

The Crown Prince's arrival brought waves of respectful greetings throughout the court. Chen Ji bowed with the crowd, his sidelong glances assessing this pivotal figure who would soon shape his destiny. The Crown Prince appeared around thirty years old, with refined features and an elegant demeanor, yet his eyes were so profound it was impossible to see through them. Wearing bright yellow princely robes, every gesture carried an inherent majestic authority. After taking his seat, the Crown Prince's gaze swept across the court before finally settling on Chen Ji, nodding slightly: "Grand Tutor Chen has traveled a long way,辛苦了. I have already prepared a banquet in the Eastern Palace. After today's court discussion concludes, Grand Tutor shall accompany me." Chen Ji bowed respectfully: "Your subject obeys." His voice was calm and humble, seemingly just an ordinary scholar. But only he knew the weight of the Crown Prince's words—this meant he was formally included in the core circle of the Crown Prince, and would face greater storms.

dialogue.content: After the court session, Chen Ji followed the Crown Prince to the Eastern Palace. Ye Qing had long been waiting in the shadows, and after Chen Ji gave a slight nod, he silently merged into the darkness. The banquet was set in an elegant courtyard of the Eastern Palace, surrounded by clusters of blooming flowers and subtle fragrance wafting through the air. The Crown Prince raised his cup inviting Chen Ji to drink together, his manner extremely cordial in words. But Chen Ji knew this Crown Prince before him was far from as simple as he appeared—anyone who could stand firm in the succession struggle surely had depths of cunning beyond measure. As expected, after several cups of wine, the Crown Prince suddenly spoke: "Grand Tutor Chen, there is something this one does not understand." He set down his wine cup, gazing intently at Chen Ji, "Your master—that mysterious elder, why would he choose to recommend you to me at this particular time?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, though his expression remained unchanged. He had anticipated this question long ago, even preparing several answers. But just as he prepared to speak, the Tianji Record in his sleeve suddenly grew warm—a warning of impending danger.

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes in contemplation for a moment, then raised his gaze to the Crown Prince, his eyes carrying appropriate candor: "Reporting to Your Highness, my master once said that the catastrophe of Tianqing Sect originated from internal power struggles and collusion with external enemies within the sect. My master was unwilling to see more innocent people drawn into this vortex, therefore ordered me to descend from the mountain, using my limited abilities to assist a wise ruler and bring peace to the world." He paused, his voice slightly lowering, "As for why I chose Your Highness...my master said a phrase I still don't fully understand—'The heavenly mandate is set, the imperial dynasty shall flourish.'" The Crown Prince's eyes flickered slightly, clearly quite satisfied with this answer. He laughed heartily, raising his cup: "What excellent words—'The heavenly mandate is set!' Grand Tutor Chen's master is truly a remarkable person." But just as he tilted his head back to drink, Chen Ji noticed a subtle, ungraspable glint in the Crown Prince's eyes—that was not trust, but rather... scrutiny. This discovery made alarm bells ring in Chen Ji's heart. The Crown Prince was far more suspicious than he appeared, and every move Chen Ji made was under this Crown Prince's watchful gaze.

choice.prompt: The Crown Prince's scrutiny made Chen Ji realize his situation was more dangerous than anticipated. He needed to balance gaining trust while maintaining an air of mystery:

choices.text: Take the initiative to show goodwill
choices.description: Reveal part of his abilities to the Crown Prince, demonstrating sincere willingness to cooperate
choices.visible_cost: Exposing his trump cards may cause the Crown Prince to be wary
choices.visible_reward: Rapidly gain the Crown Prince's trust, deepening the bond
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince may become even more vigilant as a result
choices.process_label: 陈机决定展示部分实力换取信任

dialogue.content: Chen Ji set down his wine cup, his expression becoming serious. He extended his hand, spiritual light faintly gathering at his fingertips—that was the hallmark of late Foundation Building. A flicker of surprise crossed the Crown Prince's eyes; he hadn't expected this seemingly frail Grand Tutor to possess such considerable cultivation. Chen Ji withdrew the spiritual light, his tone sincere: "Your Highness, I won't hide it from you—though my cultivation is shallow, I possess one special ability—when things are about to happen, I occasionally can have vague premonitions." He looked into the Crown Prince's eyes, each word clearly articulated, "I am willing to use this ability to serve Your Highness with the utmost loyalty." The Crown Prince's expression finally changed. He stared at Chen Ji for a long while, then suddenly burst into laughter: "Excellent! What an excellent Grand Tutor Chen! This one truly did not misjudge you." He raised his wine cup: "From this day forward, you are this one's trusted minister!" Chen Ji bowed to express gratitude, yet in his heart there was little joy—for the laughter of the Crown Prince concealed something far more complex than he had imagined.

choices.description: Not fully reveal his strength, maintaining an attitude that keeps the Crown Prince curious
choices.visible_cost: May cause the Crown Prince to think there is insufficient sincerity
choices.visible_reward: Keep his trump cards, making the Crown Prince rely on him even more
choices.risk_hint: The Prince might turn to seek other cooperative partners.
choices.process_label: 陈机选择继续隐藏，保持神秘感

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, his expression remaining humble: "Your Highness flatters me. Your servant is merely a teacher who has read a few books. How could I be called a master? It is my honor to serve Your Highness." This attitude caused the Prince to frown slightly - the New Grand Tutor's demeanor was too indifferent, as if he had no interest in power. The Prince stared at him for a moment, then suddenly smiled: "Master Chen certainly knows how to maintain composure. I have met countless people eager to attach themselves to me, yet you are the first who can remain so at ease before me." He set down his wine cup, shifting topics: "However, I am curious - what cards do you have that convinced that master to safely send you to my side?" Chen Ji raised his head, meeting the Prince's scrutinizing gaze, a faint smile curling at the corner of his lips: "Your Highness, please rest assured. My cards... will naturally be revealed when the time comes." This ambiguous answer sparked interest in the Prince's eyes. He patted Chen Ji's shoulder: "Very well, I shall wait." But that force carried a distinct hint of testing.

When the banquet ended, it was already deep night. Chen Ji declined the Prince's offer to stay, walking alone out of the Eastern Palace. The night breeze brushed his face, carrying the coolness of early autumn, clearing his mind. He looked up at the night sky - stars were sparse, moonlight cold and distant. Beneath this imperial capital's sky, who knew how many overt and covert attacks, how much treachery lay hidden. Just as he stepped through the palace gate, a black shadow appeared silently by his side - it was Ye Qing. "Young Master, the tracking talisman has activated." Her voice was extremely low, "Zhao Wuhen indeed made a move tonight. He sent people to investigate the Tianqing Sect ruins, seemingly trying to find some evidence." Chen Ji kept walking without pause, yet a cold smile curled at his lips: "Let them go. I long ago arranged everything in that place." He paused, suddenly asking, "By the way, does your intelligence network at the Xuanwu Sect have any news on Han Lie?" Ye Qing's expression changed slightly: "Han Lie left the Xuanwu Sect three days ago, destination unknown. But he left behind words - 'Waste, I will personally come take your life.'"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stopped his footsteps, raising his head to emit a soft laugh. That laughter echoed through the silent street, carrying an indecipherable and ambiguous meaning. "Waste?" he quietly repeated this designation, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes, "Han Lie ah Han Lie, do you think I am still that waste you could freely bully back then?" He turned around, looking at Ye Qing, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable authority, "Transmit my order - from this moment, activate the 'Dragon Slaughter' plan. Target - Xuanwu Sect's number one genius Han Lie." Ye Qing's heart shuddered. Dragon Slaughter plan - that was the top-secret plan Chen Ji had formulated before leaving the ruins, targeting Han Lie. She had always thought it was merely something the Young Master casually said, never expecting him to truly intend to strike at the Xuanwu Sect's genius! "Young Master, this... wouldn't it be too risky?" she couldn't help but advise. Chen Ji shook his head, his gaze profound: "Han Lie will eventually come seeking me. Rather than waiting for him to be fully prepared, it's better for me to strike first." He paused, adding, "Moreover... I need something on his person."

text.content: Ye Qing wanted to say more, but Chen Ji raised his hand to stop her. "I know what you want to say." His voice was low, "Han Lie is the most dazzling genius of this generation in the Xuanwu Sect, backed by the entire sect. Moving against him equals declaring war on the Xuanwu Sect." He turned around, moonlight casting mottled shadows across his face, "But have you considered - precisely because he is strong, defeating him holds value?" He raised his hand, the Tianji Record in his sleeve faintly glowing, "I need a sufficiently earth-shaking victory to establish my position, and Han Lie... is the perfect stepping stone." Ye Qing watched this man radiating dangerous aura, suddenly understanding why he could lay such a massive chess game in such a short time. This man's ambition far exceeded her imagination. Chen Ji gazed at the distant imperial city's outline, his eyes shining with determination to win: "The chess game of the dynasty has just begun. And I, Chen Ji... intend to become the chess player."

Just then, a blinding meteor streaked across the imperial city's sky. That meteor trailed a long tail, directly falling toward Chen Ji's location. Ye Qing's face changed drastically; just as she was about to intercept, Chen Ji raised his hand to stop her. He stood motionless, watching that meteor suddenly halt three feet away from him, transforming into an ancient jade slip. The jade slip's surface was carved with a symbol Chen Ji knew too well - that was the mark of the Tianji Record. He reached out to take the jade slip, and a stream of information instantly flooded his mind: "The fifth page seal of the Tianji Record has loosened; the seventh Heavenly Fate fragment's aura has been detected by the Heavenly Eye. Within three days, someone will definitely come to probe." Chen Ji gripped the jade slip tightly, his knuckles turning white. The Heavenly Eye's reaction was faster than he anticipated. He raised his head toward the sky - that black curtain of night seemed to transform into an invisible eye, secretly watching him. "Interesting." he murmured softly, a meaningful smile curling at his lips, "Since you want to watch, I will show you a grand performance."

Chen Ji put the jade slip into his sleeve, turning to Ye Qing: "Plans have changed. The Dragon Slaughter operation is postponed. I need you to do something else." He took out a token from his chest - the same one he had given Ye Qing earlier, "In three days, there will be a grand auction in the imperial capital. I want you to infiltrate it and closely monitor every major faction representative participating in the bidding. Especially..." he paused, a sharp glint flashing in his eyes, "People from the Holy Sect." Ye Qing took the token, her expression solemn: "Does Young Master suspect the Holy Sect will interfere in imperial affairs?" Chen Ji nodded, his voice low: "My younger sister is still in the Holy Sect's hands, and the seventh Heavenly Fate fragment involves the Heavenly Eye. There must be a connection between these." He raised his head to gaze into the distance, an uncommon softness flickering in his eyes, "Chen Nian... wait for me, elder brother will come to retrieve you soon." Ye Qing watched his expression, sighing inwardly. So even this seemingly cold-blooded man had such a tender side. She silently put away the token and vanished into the night.

dialogue.content: After Ye Qing left, Chen Ji stood alone on the empty street. He took out the Tianji Record from his sleeve; the golden light on the fourth page circulated in his palm, casting his face in alternating brightness and shadow. He closed his eyes, the Tianji Record's abilities unfurling in his mind - scenes that would occur within three hours flashed like a carousel. He saw the auction three days later, saw the Holy Sect representative's determined and confident gaze; saw Han Lie striding into the imperial capital with great momentum, his face twisting with rage upon learning his identity; and also saw... a vague figure standing in some dark corner, watching him with eyes full of hatred. That figure was too blurry, as if deliberately concealed by some force, yet that familiar sensation made Chen Ji's heart tighten. His eyes snapped open, cold
